title: RedstoneProtect
description: Stop water accidents destroying your redstone builds.
body:
### Stop water accidents destroying your redstone builds. Water and redstone just dont mix well - but sometimes, they still need to be combined. Unfortunately, even a small accident can destroy hours of carefully designed work.

This simple plugin prevents exactly that from happening. Water wont destroy your redstone ever again!
Built out of personal necessity.
Commands /redprot pause --> Toggles protection for redstone components /redprot update --> Updates the plugin if possible
